subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The professor did an __objective__ evaluation.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"objective"** means not influenced by personal feelings or opinions in considering and representing facts. (वस्तुनिष्ठ)

 
 
• **Example:** The judge gave an **objective** assessment of the case based solely on the evidence presented.
 
 
 
• **"Unbiased"** means showing no prejudice for or against something; impartial. (निष्पक्ष)
 
 
• **Example:** The committee's decision was **unbiased **and based on merit.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct substitution for 'objective' is 'unbiased'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unfair** (अनुचित): Not based on or behaving according to the principles of equality and justice.

 
 
• **Example:** It was **unfair** to blame him for something he didn't do.
 
 
 
• **Unjust** (अन्यायपूर्ण): Not based on or behaving according to what is morally right and fair.
 
 
• **Example:** The **unjust **treatment of the workers led to a strike.
 
 
 
• **Prejudiced** (पक्षपाती): Having or showing a dislike or distrust that is derived from prejudice; bigoted.
 
 
• **Example:** The **prejudiced **remarks made by the official were condemned by all.
 
 

3e:Tae0,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**</p
